lines: Let's make the compensation plan simple — just what it means for your paycheck.
One term to know: B.V., or Business Volume. For each product, Apex designates a Business Volume.
That B.V. is simply the amount your commission is based on. That's all you need to remember.
You get paid two ways. First, a commission on the B.V. of everything you personally sell.
Second, override income — a share that comes back to you as your team sells too.
As you rank up, you earn on more levels of your team, and your share grows.
Reach new ranks and you also unlock one-time bonuses along the way.
One simple rule to stay qualified: keep a little personal volume each month.
That's it. Sell, build a team, rank up. The plan rewards all three.
Now you know what you're building. Next, we learn how to actually find people. Let's go.
